sentences.en: We are in the middle of wildfire season here in California.
sentences.zh: 加州目前正处于山火季的中期。

sentences.en: There are more than a dozen currently burning across the state.
sentences.zh: 全州范围内目前有十几处山火正在燃烧。

sentences.en: And so we're dedicating two episodes to this issue.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将用两期节目来探讨这个问题。

sentences.en: Last week, we explored the work of Jack Cohen.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们探讨了杰克·科恩的工作。

sentences.en: He's a Forest Service scientist who, back in the 1980s,
sentences.zh: 他是一位林务局的科学家，早在20世纪80年代，

sentences.en: started to argue that instead of fighting fires,
sentences.zh: 他就开始主张，与其一味地扑灭火灾，

sentences.en: we should focus more energy on building homes that were better designed to withstand fire.
sentences.zh: 我们更应投入精力去建造更能抵御火灾的房屋。

sentences.en: He helped define and popularize the idea of defensible space,
sentences.zh: 他帮助定义并推广了“可防御空间”的概念，

sentences.en: which is the buffer you should create between a building on your property
sentences.zh: 也就是在你房产内的建筑物

sentences.en: and the grass, trees, and other flammable materials that surround it.
sentences.zh: 与周围的草地、树木及其他易燃物之间应留出的缓冲地带。

sentences.en: This week, we're going to spend time in one community in Southern California,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将走进南加州的一个社区，

sentences.en: which is frequently threatened by fire
sentences.zh: 它经常受到火灾的威胁，

sentences.en: and is grappling with what it means to rebuild over and over again.
sentences.zh: 并正在努力应对一次又一次重建所带来的困境。

sentences.en: When Daryl Cagle moved to Montecito, California as a kid in 1964,
sentences.zh: 1964年，当达里尔·卡格尔还是个孩子时，他搬到了加州的蒙特西托，
那曾是一个安静的小镇。

sentences.en: The kind of place where his single mother, who worked as a schoolteacher,
sentences.zh: 那是一个单身母亲——也就是他的母亲，一位学校老师——

sentences.en: Montecito used to be a very normal neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 蒙特西托曾经是一个非常普通的社区。

sentences.en: Normal people with normal jobs could afford affordable houses there.
sentences.zh: 普通人从事着普通的工作，就能在那里买得起房。

sentences.en: Montecito has changed a lot since then.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，蒙特西托发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: It's now famously home to Rob Lowe and Oprah
sentences.zh: 如今，这里成了罗伯·洛和奥普拉等名人的著名居所，

sentences.en: and not so many single mothers and schoolteachers.
sentences.zh: 却鲜有单身母亲和学校老师的身影。

sentences.en: The housing prices have gone crazy and the demographics of town are just oddly extreme.
sentences.zh: 房价已经疯涨，人口结构也变得极其怪异。

sentences.en: But it's a lovely place and it's where I grew up
sentences.zh: 但它依然是个可爱的地方，是我成长的地方，

sentences.en: and it's very comforting to be in the place that is so familiar.
sentences.zh: 身处如此熟悉的地方会让人感到非常安心。

sentences.en: Nestled between the mountains and the Pacific, right next to Santa Barbara,
sentences.zh: 蒙特西托坐落在群山与太平洋之间，紧邻圣巴巴拉，

sentences.en: Montecito is very charming and very geographically isolated.
sentences.zh: 既迷人又在地理上相对隔绝。

sentences.en: I can see why so many celebrities want to live there.
sentences.zh: 我能理解为什么这么多名人都想住在这里。

sentences.en: That's Susie Cagle, the reporter for our story this week and Daryl's daughter.
sentences.zh: 说话的是苏西·卡格尔，本期节目的记者，也是达里尔的女儿。

sentences.en: The landscape is this mix of desert and coast with soaring hills,
sentences.zh: 这里的景观融合了沙漠与海岸，有着高耸的山丘、

sentences.en: natural hot springs, and cool, dewy mornings.
sentences.zh: 天然温泉，以及凉爽、湿润的清晨。

sentences.en: The hillsides are covered with evergreen chaparral,
sentences.zh: 山坡上覆盖着常绿的灌木丛，

sentences.en: a plant community characterized by scrubby brush,
sentences.zh: 这是一种以矮小灌木为特征的植物群落，

sentences.en: and the neighborhoods are lined with fragrant eucalyptus.
sentences.zh: 社区里则种满了芬芳的桉树。

sentences.en: But Montecito's beautiful landscape is also what makes the community
sentences.zh: 但蒙特西托美丽的景观也正是让该社区
特别容易遭受山火侵袭的原因。

sentences.en: The native chaparral covering the hills is drought
sentences.zh: 覆盖山丘的原生灌木丛在生长的前20年左右，

sentences.en: and relatively fire-resistant for the first 20 years or so of its life.
sentences.zh: 具有一定的抗旱和相对的防火能力。

sentences.en: But then it dries out into rich fire fuel.
sentences.zh: 但之后它们会干枯，变成丰富的火源燃料。

sentences.en: Then there's the invasive eucalyptus trees.
sentences.zh: 此外还有入侵物种桉树。

sentences.en: Their shaggy bark and flammable oils make them burst into fireballs
sentences.zh: 它们粗糙的树皮和易燃的油脂在山火中受热时，

sentences.en: as they heat up during a wildfire.
sentences.zh: 会瞬间变成一个个火球。

sentences.en: They look like matchsticks when they catch,
sentences.zh: 一旦着火，它们就像火柴棍一样，

sentences.en: and pieces of their bark fly off to start other blazes nearby.
sentences.zh: 剥落的树皮碎片会飞散开来，引发附近的其他火灾。

sentences.en: The slender canyons that sit below the hilltops of Montecito
sentences.zh: 蒙特西托山顶下方狭长的峡谷，

sentences.en: are cozy little spaces where that fire can easily take hold.
sentences.zh: 是火势极易蔓延的隐蔽空间。

sentences.en: Which it does when the town's so-called sundowner winds
blow hot, dry air from the desert up over the mountains and through the canyons.
sentences.zh: 将沙漠的热干空气吹过山脉并穿过峡谷时，火灾便会发生。

sentences.en: The region endures a major fire once every 10 years or so.
sentences.zh: 该地区大约每10年就会经历一次重大火灾。

sentences.en: The year my dad and grandmother moved to Montecito in 1964,
sentences.zh: 1964年，我父亲和祖母搬到蒙特西托的那一年，

sentences.en: a wildfire called the Coyote Fire scorched 67,000 acres just north of them.
sentences.zh: 一场名为“郊狼大火”的山火烧毁了他们以北6.7万英亩的土地。

sentences.en: It burned 106 homes and killed one firefighter.
sentences.zh: 火灾烧毁了106所房屋，并导致一名消防员丧生。

sentences.en: My dad says he doesn't remember it.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说他不记得那次火灾了。

sentences.en: For this landscape, fire is predictable and it is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 对于这片土地而言，火灾是可预见的，也是不可避免的。

sentences.en: And coupled with a multi-year drought, it's becoming unmanageable.
sentences.zh: 再加上多年的干旱，情况正变得难以控制。

sentences.en: We had no idea that fires were going to increase in size and frequency like they have.
sentences.zh: 我们根本没想到火灾的规模和频率会像现在这样增加。

sentences.en: Maybe it's like the frog in the pot slowly coming to a boil.
sentences.zh: 也许这就像温水煮青蛙一样。

sentences.en: For decades, my dad and grandmother and the other residents of Montecito
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我父亲、祖母以及蒙特西托的其他居民，

sentences.en: exhibited a kind of stubborn pioneer streak that characterizes a lot of Californians.
sentences.zh: 展现出了一种许多加州人所特有的顽强开拓精神。

sentences.en: After fires, they'd rebuild and continue with their lives.
sentences.zh: 火灾过后，他们会重建家园，继续生活。

sentences.en: My grandmother had been driven from her home in Texas by the drought in the 30s
sentences.zh: 我祖母曾在30年代因干旱被迫离开德克萨斯的家园，

sentences.en: that sent so many Dust Bowl refugees fleeing for a better life.
sentences.zh: 那场干旱让无数“尘暴区”难民流离失所，寻求更好的生活。

sentences.en: So what was a little fire?
sentences.zh: 所以，一点小火又算得了什么呢？

sentences.en: But that kind of optimism is getting harder to sustain
sentences.zh: 但随着火灾变得越来越频繁、越来越猛烈，

sentences.en: as fires become more frequent and more intense.
sentences.zh: 那种乐观情绪正变得越来越难以维持。

sentences.en: And as communities are forced to reckon with rebuilding again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 社区被迫一次又一次地面对重建的现实。

sentences.en: We're reevaluating, hey, how are we going to deal with this?
sentences.zh: 我们正在重新评估：嘿，我们该如何应对这一切？

sentences.en: Rob Hazard is the deputy fire marshal for Santa Barbara County
sentences.zh: 罗伯·哈扎德是圣巴巴拉县的副消防局长，

sentences.en: and a fifth-generation Santa Barbara resident.
sentences.zh: 也是圣巴巴拉的第五代居民。

sentences.en: We are entering a new time when, because of the weather and the impacts of climate change
sentences.zh: 我们正在进入一个新时代，由于天气、气候变化的影响

sentences.en: and long-term extended drought, that fires have reached a new level of intensity
sentences.zh: 以及长期的持续干旱，火灾的强度达到了一个新的水平，

sentences.en: that's causing us to have to change our tactics, our strategies,
sentences.zh: 这迫使我们必须改变我们的战术和策略。

sentences.en: and we're stretched to the limit, all of our resources.
sentences.zh: 我们已经竭尽所能，动用了所有资源。

sentences.en: Thirteen years after my dad arrived in Montecito,
sentences.zh: 在我父亲抵达蒙特西托十三年后，

sentences.en: he and my grandmother faced their first close call with wildfire.
sentences.zh: 他和祖母第一次遭遇了野火的威胁。

sentences.en: A young man flew his box kite into a power line on a warm summer evening,
sentences.zh: 一个夏日的傍晚，一名年轻人放的箱式风筝撞上了电线，

sentences.en: causing a spark, which turned into a fire.
sentences.zh: 引发了火花，进而酿成了火灾。

sentences.en: The sundowner winds pushed the growing blaze into my dad and grandmother's dense neighborhood,
sentences.zh: 圣安娜风将不断蔓延的火势推向了我父亲和祖母居住的密集社区，

sentences.en: which had only just been built in the early 60s.
sentences.zh: 那个社区在60年代初才刚刚建成。

sentences.en: We got a car full of quickly gathered mementos and the clothes on our back,
sentences.zh: 我们匆忙收拾了一车纪念品，带上随身衣物，

sentences.en: and we drove out, and next morning came back and the house was gone.
sentences.zh: 开车逃离，第二天回来时，房子已经没了。

sentences.en: The house had burned completely, from the roof down to the foundation.
sentences.zh: 房子被烧得精光，从屋顶一直到地基。

sentences.en: In fact, the chimney was left standing and the chimney was fine.
sentences.zh: 事实上，烟囱还立在那里，而且完好无损。

sentences.en: A hundred and ninety-five houses burned in the fire.
sentences.zh: 那场火灾烧毁了一百九十五栋房屋。

sentences.en: Many of them, like my dad's, had roofs made of wood shingles,
sentences.zh: 其中许多房子和我父亲的一样，屋顶是木瓦做的，

sentences.en: with cozy air gaps in between, perfect for flying embers to catch.
sentences.zh: 中间有舒适的空气间隙，非常容易引燃飞溅的火星。

sentences.en: Like kindling on top of houses.
sentences.zh: 就像在房子上堆了引火柴一样。

sentences.en: The county fire marshal at the time reported watching wood shingles lift off of one burning house,
sentences.zh: 当时的县消防局长报告说，他亲眼看到木瓦从一栋燃烧的房子上掀起，

sentences.en: fly through the air, and land on another house with a wood shingle roof.
sentences.zh: 飞过空中，落到另一栋铺着木瓦屋顶的房子上。

sentences.en: He called it a wood roof conflagration.
sentences.zh: 他称之为“木屋顶大火灾”。

sentences.en: And was there ever any question that grandmother wanted to rebuild,
sentences.zh: 祖母当时有没有考虑过要不要重建，

sentences.en: or was that just a given?
sentences.zh: 还是说这根本不用考虑？

sentences.en: Well, she had fire insurance, and rebuilding the house was covered,
sentences.zh: 嗯，她有火灾保险，重建房屋在承保范围内，

sentences.en: and she had a job working for the schools in town,
sentences.zh: 而且她在镇上的学校有份工作，

sentences.en: and I don't think there was much question about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这根本没什么好犹豫的。

sentences.en: If there's an upside to destructive wildfires,
sentences.zh: 如果说毁灭性的野火有什么积极的一面，

sentences.en: it's that they give a community the chance for a design do-over.
sentences.zh: 那就是它们给了社区一个重新设计的机会。

sentences.en: However, towns have a rare opportunity to modify the landscape
sentences.zh: 然而，城镇确实难得有机会去改造景观，

sentences.en: and rebuild houses in ways that make them more resistant to disasters in the future.
sentences.zh: 并以更具灾害抵御能力的方式重建房屋。

sentences.en: Through the 50s and 60s, Montecito made a handful of changes to prepare for future fires.
sentences.zh: 在50和60年代，蒙特西托做出了一些改变，以应对未来的火灾。

sentences.en: The Forest Service tore up some of the flammable chaparral with bulldozers
sentences.zh: 林务局用推土机铲除了一些易燃的灌木丛，

sentences.en: until fears over toxic chemicals and a growing environmental movement
sentences.zh: 直到后来人们对有毒化学物质的担忧以及环保运动的兴起，
才在70年代废除了该项目。
在特别容易发生火灾的社区，

sentences.en: the county began requiring people to build their houses
sentences.zh: 县政府开始要求人们建造房屋时，
必须使用防火屋顶和墙壁，

sentences.en: and with wide areas of clear, open space around them,
sentences.zh: 并且在房屋周围留出宽阔的空地，
也就是所谓的“可防御空间”。

sentences.en: Each new disaster inspires a new edit.
sentences.zh: 每一次新的灾难都会激发新的改进。

sentences.en: When my grandmother rebuilt, she changed the design of their house.
sentences.zh: 祖母重建房子时，改变了设计方案。

sentences.en: Those nightmarish wood roofs were now banned,
sentences.zh: 那些噩梦般的木屋顶现在被禁用了，

sentences.en: so she replaced hers with concrete,
sentences.zh: 所以她把屋顶换成了混凝土，

sentences.en: and paved over the tiny surrounding yard.
sentences.zh: 并把周围狭小的院子铺上了路面。

sentences.en: They did what they could to make their space more defensible.
sentences.zh: 他们尽其所能让自己的空间更具防御性。

sentences.en: But there can be limits to the effectiveness of defensible space.
sentences.zh: 但可防御空间的有效性是有局限的。

sentences.en: That's especially true in a dense community where people have small lots.
sentences.zh: 在人们地块狭小的密集社区尤其如此。

sentences.en: We have neighbors, and neighbors have rights,
sentences.zh: 我们有邻居，邻居也有权利，

sentences.en: and you can only clear brush from your own land.
sentences.zh: 而且你只能清理自己土地上的灌木。

sentences.en: So even if you're diligent about keeping your land carefully maintained,
sentences.zh: 所以，即使你勤勤恳恳地维护自己的土地，

sentences.en: your neighbor might have a propane barbecue,
sentences.zh: 你的邻居可能有一个丙烷烧烤架，

sentences.en: or a tall stand of lovely eucalyptus trees.
sentences.zh: 或者种了一大片漂亮的桉树。

sentences.en: And their house could catch your house on fire.
sentences.zh: 他们的房子可能会引燃你的房子。

sentences.en: In Montecito, preventing fires can often prove more controversial
sentences.zh: 在蒙特西托，预防火灾往往比灾后重建更具争议性。
由消防员设置和管理的计划烧除，

sentences.en: Prescribed fires set and managed by firefighters
sentences.zh: 曾经被认为是消耗燃料的有效方法。

sentences.en: were once considered an effective way to burn off fuel.
sentences.zh: 但在部分地区为灌木丛的加州沿海地带，

sentences.en: But in coastal California, with its part chaparral,
sentences.zh: 这种做法几乎不再使用了。
所谓的受控火灾很容易失控，

sentences.en: The so-called controlled fires can easily grow out of control
sentences.zh: 并摧毁宝贵的生态系统和社区。

sentences.en: and destroy valuable ecosystems and neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 而且，维护山脊上的防火带既昂贵，

sentences.en: And ridgetop, firebreaks are expensive to maintain.

sentences.zh: 这些大片被清理出来的土地旨在为消防车、水带和手动工具腾出空间。

sentences.en: These big stretches of cleared land are meant to make space
sentences.zh: 它们为消防员提供了进入火场前线的便捷通道。

sentences.en: for fire engines, hoses, and hand tools.
They provide firefighters with ready access to the front.
sentences.zh: 不喜欢看到郁郁葱葱的山坡上留下巨大的伤疤，
即使这是为了保护他们自己。

sentences.en: don't like to see big scars across the lush mountainsides,
sentences.zh: 所以罗布·哈扎德和其他县消防员，

sentences.en: even when it's for their own protection.
sentences.zh: 肩负着一场注定失败的战斗，

sentences.en: So Rob Hazard and other county firefighters
sentences.zh: 在无法掌控自然和文明的情况下，与两者抗争。

sentences.en: are tasked with a losing battle,
sentences.zh: 我们很多讨论都围绕着，

sentences.en: fighting nature and civilization without control over either one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，社区规划，这才是我们真正需要着手解决的地方。

sentences.en: A lot of our discussions revolve around,
sentences.zh: 我们很多讨论都围绕着，

sentences.en: well, community planning, that's really where we need to be tackling this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，社区规划，这才是我们真正需要着手解决的地方。

sentences.en: We need to plan our communities better.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更好地规划我们的社区。

sentences.en: We need to build our houses more durable and resilient
sentences.zh: 我们需要让房屋建造得更耐用、更具韧性，

sentences.en: We need to stop building in the wildlands.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止在荒野地区进行建设。

sentences.en: is that we've already built out our communities.
And we're only adding to them.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还在不断扩建它们。

sentences.en: As those communities grow and spread inland,
sentences.zh: 随着这些社区向内陆生长和蔓延，

sentences.en: they've gotten closer to what used to be considered wilderness.
sentences.zh: 它们已经越来越靠近曾经被视为荒野的地方。

sentences.en: Now it's called the wildland-urban interface.
sentences.zh: 现在这被称为“荒野-城市交界地带”。

sentences.en: Researchers expect that a million new houses
sentences.zh: 研究人员预计，在未来几十年里，

sentences.en: will be built in those high fire hazard areas of California
sentences.zh: 加州这些高火灾风险地区

sentences.en: As urban populations have moved closer to the wildlands,
sentences.zh: 随着城市人口向荒野地区迁移，

sentences.en: we get a whole new generation of people
who aren't familiar with the risks inherent
sentences.zh: 他们并不了解在南加州荒野旁居住

sentences.en: with living next to the wildlands in Southern California.

sentences.zh: 其实，现在全州都是如此。

sentences.en: The reality is there really isn't a wilderness in Southern California.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，南加州根本不存在所谓的荒野。

sentences.en: Anywhere in the state of California,
we can have a fire start in a wilderness area
sentences.zh: 火灾都可能在荒野地区燃起，

sentences.en: and be in the back door of a major metropolitan area
At the same time communities are encroaching on what used to be wildlands,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在社区不断侵占曾经的荒野时，

sentences.en: climate change is making wildfires more frequent and intense.
sentences.zh: 气候变化正在使野火变得更加频繁和剧烈。

sentences.en: But the way we live through fire has stayed remarkably the same.
sentences.zh: 但我们应对火灾的生活方式却几乎没有改变。

sentences.en: local authorities rush to issue new building permits.
